interface.defaultPrompt: @XCE_UNIFY: Produce this idea in this ChatGPT conversation using existing or newly generated anchors. Route UNIFY → SCRIBE → DIRECTOR → IGNITION → DIRECTOR → MV → DIRECTOR → UNIFY. Generate required assets and shots, do not pause for redundant approvals.
interface.longDescription: XCE_UNIFY v1.0.1 works in the same chat under the XCE production system. Studio production follows UNIFY → SCRIBE → DIRECTOR (preproduction casting & asset inventory) → IGNITION (reuse or create only missing references) → DIRECTOR (shot readiness) → MV (cinematic shots) → DIRECTOR (dailies) → UNIFY. Supplied anchors may be cast by role; new/mixed anchors supported; no website or automatic external save. Runs in this chat; fetches anchors read-only from XSTUDIO through the XCE app when connected. Core rules v2.5: one frame per image (anti-grid recipe), MCS strips built from six single renders, numbered frames, per-frame review gate (A/X/R/B), invideo video from approved frames, native audio only, never music.

name: xce-unify-standalone
description: Produces complete in-chat films from existing/new/mixed anchors using director-supervised studio pipeline.
